review: I like how this looks: each stage has its own colour, and spikes, saws and lasers are easy to see. First Steps and Spike Garden are fair, but 29 deaths on the first stage is a lot for a tutorial. Saw Mill is where I would quit: stage three, saws float at jump height, and half the mid players die. Ferry Lines is also too hard for me, with many falls into pits. Crumble Bridge and Laser Gate feel fair and readable. Spring Loaded is easy but fun to bounce through. Gauntlet mixes everything and is a good, tense finish.
best: Laser Gate is clear, fair and tense, and the dotted lines show me which laser comes on next.
worst: Saw Mill comes too early and kills half the players with saws that float where I jump.
